Pettādīkṣita
or Peddā Dīkṣita of Kauṇḍinyagotra; son of Trivedi Nārāyaṇādhvarin; pupil of his paternal uncle Dharmarājādhvarīndra, a. of Vedāntaparibhāṣā.
--C. Sāra on Tattvacintāmaṇiprakāśa of Rucidatta.

(b).
--C. Prakāśikā on Vedāntaparibhāṣā of Dharmarājādhvarīndra. Adyar D.

Pettādīkṣita
--Bhāṭṭaparibhāṣā on the six pramāṇas of Bhāṭṭamīmām3sā system.

Pettārācārya
alias Paitārya; father of Varāhadeśika (a. of Kriyākairavacandrikā).
